messages:
support_ana: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting hourly usage stopped updating around 02:00 UTC. Console graphs flatline for that window and hourly rows are missing. Adding logs and one example tenant. @ryan_dataeng
ryan_dataeng: Thanks — can you paste a tenant id and a quick symptom snapshot?
support_ana: tenant: acme-inc (t-3421). Graph flat from 02:00–06:00 UTC. Ingest shows events present in raw_events but hourly_rollups table has no rows after 01:45 for that tenant.
sanjay_sre: Looking at infra — kafka consumer group 'usage-ingest' has very high lag on partition 7 since ~02:05. Consumer pod is pegged CPU. There was an ad-hoc backfill run around 01:50 that reprocessed a large date range; looks like it monopolized worker slots.
luis_prod: I pulled logs from the ingest pod. Notable snippets:
```
WARN backpressure: queue_size=120000 pause=true
ERROR kafka.consumer: OffsetOutOfRange for partition 7
INFO backfill: requeued 198342 messages
```
ryan_dataeng: Ok — quick triage checklist: 1) inspect kafka offsets & consumer lag 2) check pod restarts and OOMs 3) confirm write latency to analytics-prod.hourly_rollups. Who can check pods?
support_ana: pods show usage-ingest-0 at 100% CPU and two OOM restarts since 02:10. Last successful write to hourly_rollups at 01:45 UTC.
sanjay_sre: Scaling consumer deployment now (1 -> 4 replicas). Also bumping consumer concurrency to 8 and increasing fetch.max.bytes to help throughput. Patching backfill to stream instead of bulk requeue.
ingest-bot: autoscaler: deployment usage-ingest scaled from 1 -> 4 replicas (trigger: cpu > 80%)
ryan_dataeng: I'm kicking off a targeted backfill for acme-inc only (narrow window) and using direct idempotent writes to hourly_rollups to avoid dupes. Throttling to avoid reintroducing backpressure.
support_ana: Suppressing noisy 'missing-hourly-rows' alerts for acme-inc while we remediate so on-call doesn't get paged.
luis_prod: After scaling, consumer lag trending down but still ~150k messages behind. At current throughput estimate ~90 minutes to catch up.
sanjay_sre: Deployed a small fix at 03:10 UTC that prevented backfill from requeueing already-acked messages (root cause).
support_ana: :thumbsup: I'll update affected customer threads and watch the console. Please add runbook steps so next time we don't escalate as far.
ryan_dataeng: Will open a short postmortem and remediation ticket. Proposed action items: default higher consumer parallelism for peak windows, add guardrail to backfill DAG to limit concurrency, and add a 'backfill-induced-lag' dashboard/alert.
support_ana: Update 04:20 UTC — console hourly rows resumed for acme-inc; values are catching up. Leaving monitoring on for the next 2h, will mark resolved once fully caught up.
